question: dame la comisión efectiva en porcentaje de cada nivel de riesgo de comercio, ordenada de mayor a menor
sql:
SELECT merchant_sk, risk_tier, (fee_minor * 100.0 / NULLIF(gross_eur_minor, 0)) AS effective_fee_pct
FROM fact_settlement_batch fsb
JOIN dim_merchant dm ON fsb.merchant_id = dm.merchant_id
GROUP BY merchant_sk, risk_tier
ORDER BY effective_fee_pct DESC
